flash_697106.description: France accuses Iran of a massive cyberattack that damaged refrigeration systems at 700 retailers, as similar incidents across Europe prompt warnings in Israel.

flash_697105.description: Security personnel at Washington Hebrew Congregation intercept a Virginia man carrying a loaded revolver. Police arrest him, and no injuries reported.

flash_697104.description: Netanyahu reportedly wants Trump to resume strikes on Iran, while Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and Turkey urge Washington to prioritize diplomacy.

flash_697102.description: Saudi Arabia announced that it had intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis from Yemen toward the southern part of the country.

flash_697100.description: Maccabi Tel Aviv's basketball team overcame a 23-point deficit to defeat Hapoel Tel Aviv 86-75 on Monday evening, claiming the Winner Cup for the 12th time in club history.

flash_697098.description:
IDF troops operating overnight on the outskirts of the village of Burqa in Samaria spotted several terrorists preparing to throw rocks at a highway used by Israeli vehicles.

According to the IDF Spokesperson's Unit, the operation was conducted in an area where several rock-throwing attacks against Israeli vehicles have recently occurred. The troops opened fire at the terrorists to eliminate the threat, and hits were confirmed.

flash_697097.description: During a solidarity mission to Israel, Farley Weiss warned of growing anti-Israel sentiment in American politics but stressed that Israel still has powerful friends in Washington. "We have to be on the offensive," he said.

flash_697136.description: Likud MK-elect Elisha Medan, who lost both legs fighting in Gaza, vows to stand on his prosthetics during his Knesset swearing-in despite severe pain.

flash_697135.description: At just 24, Bennett's Yonatan Shalev becomes the youngest MK in Israeli history, pledging to represent a generation he says has been abandoned.

flash_697133.description: Actress and director Einat Weizman, who describes herself as anti-Zionist, is moving to Athens with her family following professional and political difficulties.

flash_697131.description: The US Food and Drug Administration has ordered the addition of a warning about a rare eye disease that can cause sudden vision loss.

flash_697129.description: An MDA volunteer discovers a swastika drawn on the Israeli flag displayed on his emergency response vehicle in Jerusalem, with the MDA logos defaced.

flash_697127.description: It is forbidden by Torah law to inscribe letters or designs into the skin in a manner that causes them to remain there permanently. The prohibition applies equally to men and women, and to every part of the body.

flash_697125.description: The Israel Nature and Parks Authority is warning against diving and snorkeling near Hadera power stations due to the return of sharks in the area.

flash_697123.description: We Jews stood up for the rights of others because we believed in America. Now America must demonstrate that those same rights protect us. Words are not enough.Opinion.

flash_697121.description: From the American midterms to British school corridors, the past few weeks have exposed how readily politicians exploit hostility to Israel and how easily Western societies excuse hatred of Jews. Opinion.

flash_697119.description: Eisenkot: Matan Kahana to be appointed as Knesset Speaker

flash_697117.description:
The United Torah Judaism (UTJ) faction will convene its first faction meeting this afternoon, with discussions focusing on whether to cooperate with the right-wing bloc in the Knesset.

During the meeting, faction members are expected to discuss whether to align themselves with the Netanyahu bloc and firmly oppose all legislative initiatives advanced by the opposition bloc.

flash_697116.description: The Israel Tax Authority recommends taxing aircraft departing from Israel, potentially raising ticket prices by about NIS 58 for flights to Europe and NIS 274 for long-haul flights.

flash_697114.description:
Houthi-affiliated media outlets reported early Tuesday morning that the Saudi Air Force had struck energy facilities in Sana'a, the capital of Yemen.

According to the reports, the targets included a gas facility in the northern part of the city and a building belonging to the Houthis' oil company.

flash_697112.description: Gaza-born activist Ahmed Moor launches a 2028 Senate campaign against John Fetterman, targeting the Pennsylvania Democrat's staunch support for Israel.

flash_697110.description: A Long Island man is accused of making shooting gestures and shouting antisemitic threats at a mother and her young daughter inside a wholesale store.

flash_697108.description: Rep. Thomas Massie moves to force a House vote on eight impeachment articles against Pete Hegseth, prompting Trump to defend his Secretary of War.

flash_697165.description: In 1929, Rabbi Avraham Yitzhak HaKohen Kook hosted Rebbe Yosef Yitzhak Schneerson in his Jerusalem home during the Chabad Rabbi's visit to the Holy Land. Rabbi Kook exhorted his distinguished guest to bring his followers to the Chosen Land.

flash_697164.description: At Arutz Sheva's Knesset studio, MK Yitshak Goldknopf said UTJ would follow its rabbis' ruling. He said coalition partners failed haredi needs, blamed the Religious Zionist Party for budget cuts and urged recognition of haredi civilian service.

flash_697162.description: US ambassador to Israel clarifies that Trump has not ruled out further military action against Iran and also addressed political developments in Israel following the elections.

flash_697160.description: Minister Yitzhak Wasserlauf attended the Knesset swearing-in ceremony with his wife and children, when one of his sons was asked whether he was proud of his father and his answer brought a smile to everyone's face.

flash_697158.description: Eliyahu calls the unity government proposed by the Prime Minister a "national paralysis government" and warns the haredi parties against "repeating the mistake of Oslo."

flash_697156.description: Lt. Col. (res.) attorney Maurice Hirsch's new study details how the PA funds terrorists and their families via dedicated ATMs and money changers. He criticizes Israeli enforcement, urging seizure of funds and sanctions on recipients.

flash_697154.description: Knesset speaker candidate Matan Kahana told Arutz Sheva, "I see this as a significant role, a role that unites the citizens of the State of Israel". He also discussed Arab parties' support and a possible unity government.

flash_697152.description: Newly elected MK Elisha Medan rises on prosthetic legs to take oath of office, drawing applause from across the political spectrum. Herzog and Ohana urge Zionist parties to unite and avoid another election.

flash_697150.description: Around 480 Jewish and Arab runners participated Friday morning in the 12th annual 'Running Without Borders' race in Jerusalem, bringing together families from all parts of the city.

flash_697148.description: Restoration funding will be used to repair the roof, renovate the prayer hall, and establish a heritage exhibition commemorating the history of the local Jewish community.

flash_697146.description: Reflections in light of the elections. The CEC, a democratic body founded in Knesset legislation and a reflection of Israel's collective spirit, banned Ra'am and the Joint List while the Supreme Court overturned these bans because they are an undemocratic body with no basis in Knesset legislation that does not reflect Israel's collective spirit.

flash_697144.description: The opposition bloc has submitted 61 signatures to replace Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana with Matan Kahana, including signatures from members of Ra'am and the Joint List.

flash_697142.description: J.D. Vance wants to “change our relationship to Israel." This is good news for Alexander Dugin’s club, the Russian-sourced "Trojan Horse" in the Republican Party. Opinion.

flash_697140.description: Yair Lapid told Knesset members of the Beyachad faction at the faction meeting: "There is a rule that has been working in Israeli politics for 13 years: If Bennett and I are quiet - it is a sign that things are happening."

flash_697138.description: Netanyahu moves to appoint Gideon Sa'ar as Interior Minister after a 13-month vacancy, following Ofir Katz's decision to decline the position.

flash_697177.description:
Diplomats from an Arab country that maintains diplomatic relations with Israel are closely following negotiations to form a government led by Gadi Eisenkot and view the possibility of the haredi parties joining the coalition favorably, Kan 11 News reported.

According to the report, the diplomats said in closed-door discussions that the haredi parties would be "easier partners to work with" than Itamar Ben Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich.

flash_697176.description: MK Limor Sonn Har Melech calls for new elections and warns parties considering forming a government with the support of Arab lawmakers.

flash_697174.description:
Security forces were dispatched to the Palestinian Arab village of Luban ash-Sharqiya in Samaria following reports of arson and footage from the scene showing vehicles engulfed in flames, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.

The IDF stated that "forces are currently operating in the area to locate suspects and restore order. Once the fires have been extinguished, police officers and forensic investigators will enter the area under IDF protection to collect findings and evidence."

flash_697173.description: Western intelligence estimates Iran retains at least 1,700 ballistic missiles and can produce 50 more each month despite extensive US and Israeli airstrikes.

flash_697171.description: Police findings submitted to prosecutors find no election financing violations. Likud claims 1,281 complaints of election irregularities remain uninvestigated.

flash_697169.description: Minister Gila Gamliel backs Netanyahu's call for a broad-based government, saying neither bloc can govern alone and personal considerations must not stand in the way of unity.

flash_697167.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says Hamas's refusal to disarm is preventing Gaza's reconstruction, accusing the terrorist organization of exploiting humanitarian aid to rebuild its military capabilities.

flash_697163.description: Rabbi Dov Lior clarifies that worshippers praying on the Temple Mount should continue using the customary conclusions to the blessings and should not adopt the wording used when the Holy Temple stood.

flash_697161.description: Following Netanyahu's speech at the Knesset swearing-in ceremony, the Yashar party chairman ordered the cancellation of a planned negotiation meeting with Likud representatives.

flash_697159.description: In a letter to the Shin Bet chief, 15 settlers allege that Central Command continues to impose severe restrictions on them without trial or an opportunity to defend themselves.

flash_697157.description: Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana announced Tuesday evening that, following an unusual request signed by 67 MKs, a vote to elect his replacement will be held next Tuesday.

flash_697155.description: Benjamin Netanyahu's son attacked Yashar! party chairman, claiming that 'Israel may not survive him.' Eisenkot’s party lashed back.

flash_697153.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sharply criticized the Joint List and Ra'am on Tuesday evening, claiming that there is no difference between the two parties' objectives.

flash_697151.description: A confrontation erupted in the Knesset plenum after Joint List chairman Yousef Jabareen declared, "I pledge," provoking an angry reaction from Minister Itamar Ben Gvir.

flash_697149.description:
A confrontation erupted in the Knesset plenum after Joint List chairman Yousef Jabareen declared, "I pledge."

In response, Itamar Ben Gvir interrupted him, shouting, "To whom is he pledging allegiance? Is he pledging allegiance to Hamas?"

flash_697147.description: Incoming Yashar MK Shira Shapira arrived at the Knesset with a photo of her late son Aner, who threw back seven grenades on October 7. Tearfully, she said she had visited his grave before the ceremony, declaring, 'I am here on his behalf.'

flash_697196.description: Police arrested two illegal infiltrators, driver suspected of transporting them who ignored order to stop.

flash_697195.description: With the opening of the 26th Knesset, MK Simcha Rothman submitted dozens of bills, including about 20 concerning the judiciary.

flash_697193.description: Rafael's latest Ice Breaker missile carries 453-kilogram warhead, can be launched from land, air, or sea.

flash_697191.description: Washington in talks with Beirut on ceasefire in southern Lebanon, in exchange for Lebanese government curbing Hezbollah’s movements, report says.

flash_697189.description: It is incomprehensble that Israel holds elections, one party gets the most votes, but the figure at its head is not declared the elected prime minister. Opinion.

flash_697187.description:
Israeli defense company Rafael unveiled its new SUPER ICE cruise missile for the first time on Wednesday. The missile, currently under development, joins the ICE BREAKER family of missiles developed and manufactured in Israel.

The missile is equipped with a warhead weighing approximately 454 kilograms, equivalent to the weight of an MK83 bomb. It can fly at low altitudes while following the terrain, making it difficult to detect by radar, and navigate autonomously toward its target even in adverse weather conditions.

flash_697186.description: G7 foreign ministers call for new security arrangements in Lebanon before UNIFIL's withdrawal, but remain divided over how to replace the peacekeeping force.

flash_697185.description: Former President Joe Biden faces angry anti-Israel protesters during a visit to Dublin, where an object is thrown near him and two people are arrested.

flash_697184.description: A US Army officer assigned to a NATO rapid-response unit is arrested in England on suspicion of espionage linked to Russia amid growing European security concerns.

flash_697182.description: Former Hamas hostage Eli Sharabi hangs photographs of family members murdered in the October 7 massacre in his brother Sharon Sharabi's Knesset office. Watch.

flash_697180.description: The New York Times reports that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been relocated to a military base amid Iranian threats, as US intelligence warns of advanced plots against officials.

flash_697178.description: US prosecutors charge three alleged Iran-backed operatives over attacks on Jewish targets and a foiled bombing plot against a British air base housing US forces.

flash_697175.description: The House votes 211-204 to sideline impeachment proceedings against Pete Hegseth, as Trump declares victory and attacks Republican critic Thomas Massie.

flash_697172.description:
Authorities in Latvia ordered residents of the Ludza region, near the border with Belarus, to seek shelter following an "airspace threat."

Meanwhile, Lithuanian authorities announced that NATO fighter jets had been scrambled after an unidentified aerial object was detected over Belarus, heading toward the Baltic states.

flash_697170.description: In new memoir, former President Joe Biden reveals the surprisingly warm letter Donald Trump left him in the Oval Office in 2021.

flash_697228.description: David Barnea warned that Tehran is already working to rebuild its nuclear program and outlined alternatives to an agreement with the regime.

flash_697227.description:
MK Rafi Ben Shitrit of Yisrael Beytenu, father of Staff Sergeant Shimon Alroy Ben Shitrit, who fell in battle at the Nahal Oz military outpost on October 7th, submitted a bill together with members of his faction to establish a state commission of inquiry into the failures that led to the massacre.

Ben Shitrit, who said he has spent the past three years working to establish the commission, declared: "I will not rest or remain silent until a state commission of inquiry is established to uncover the truth and ensure accountability for the greatest failure in the history of the State of Israel."

flash_697225.description: Women of the Wall bring a Torah parchment sheet to Rosh Hodesh prayers, drawing objections from thousands of worshippers over the unusual move.

flash_697223.description: Following an undercover investigation, police and customs officers raided a home in Dabburiya and seized dozens of drones, including some equipped with technology for dropping explosives.

flash_697220.description:
The Prime Minister's Office reiterated on Wednesday that Israel and the United States are moving from American financial and military assistance toward a new partnership. "In 1996, Prime Minister Netanyahu said that Israel would gradually end US financial support of $1.2 billion. He did just that," the statement said.

"Thirty years later, Prime Minister Netanyahu said that Israel is strong enough economically to gradually end military support," the Prime Minister's Office added. The statement recalled Netanyahu's remarks during a May interview with CBS's 60 Minutes, in which he declared: "I want to draw down to zero the American financial support." It also cited US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who described the proposal this week as "something the Israelis themselves have offered us."

"This joint move by Prime Minister Netanyahu and President Trump shows the strength of our relationship and its ability to adapt to changing circumstances," the Prime Minister's Office concluded.

flash_697219.description: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei threatened that Iran would attack US military bases on European soil if aircraft took off from those bases to carry out strikes on Iranian territory.

flash_697218.description: The Knesset approves temporary committee appointments, granting Ra'am a seat on the Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee under Avigdor Liberman.

flash_697216.description: IDF soldiers raise modesty concerns over fitness sessions led by woman, IDF says base will adapt training.

flash_697214.description: MK Yoav Segalovitz (Ra'am) will serve as a member of the Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee. MK Yonatan Shalev (Together) will serve as an alternate member of the committee.

flash_697212.description: The Leiters clarified that while Neria has been transferred to a rehabilitation facility at Sheba Medical Center in Tel Hashomer specializing in the rehabilitation of patients with severe brain injuries who remain unconscious, his condition remains complex, and the road to recovery is still long and challenging. Neria remains unconscious and will need to undergo several additional surgeries.

flash_697210.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates call for unity government, hints of security and diplomatic challenges ahead.

flash_697208.description: MK Meir Porush criticized parties now seeking haredi support after what he described as their campaign of incitement against the community over military conscription.

flash_697206.description: New plan developed with the Jewish Federations of North America aims to boost enrollment in Jewish education, deepen students’ ties to Israel.

flash_697203.description: Over four years after Moishy Kleinerman's disappearance, his family receives demands for insurance payments, and Military Police claim he is evading enlistment.

flash_697201.description: Home Front Command activates first-ever real-time earthquake alert, using system created five years ago.

flash_697199.description:
IDF: Following the alerts activated a short while ago due to an earthquake in area of Eilat, the public is advised to follow the official instructions on the Home Front Command app and website.

The details are under review.

flash_697249.description: With coalition talks stalled, Jay Shapiro warns that Israel's political uncertainty could complicate regional diplomacy and national security, urging rival parties to form a unity government.

flash_697248.description:
Four people were injured in a traffic accident on Highway 80 near Tel Arad. A 20-year-old man was seriously injured, a 17-year-old boy sustained moderate injuries, and two others were lightly injured.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams treated the victims and evacuated them to Soroka Hospital in Be'er Sheva.

flash_697246.description: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two cruise missiles launched toward the western part of the country.

flash_697244.description: Throughout the world, after eighty years lived in relative peace, Holocaust survivors have become victims of modern antisemitic violence. Opinion.

flash_697242.description: When politicians are willing to govern, vote on national laws, and pocket state funds, they cannot simultaneously pretend to be above the state's symbolic identity. Opinion.

flash_697240.description: Former ambassador Gilad Erdan urges Netanyahu and Eisenkot to form a unity government, warning of security challenges and declining global support.

flash_697238.description: Former US Ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley rules out another presidential bid, but vows to remain politically active, promote conservative policies, and support candidates who will strengthen America.

flash_697236.description: US Central Command says American forces are working around the clock to keep the Strait of Hormuz open, enforce the naval blockade on Iran, and prevent the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps from smuggling weapons and sanctioned materials.

flash_697234.description: Chani Leiter, whose son Neria was critically injured in a ramming attack, speaks with Arutz Sheva about her son's transfer to rehabilitation.

flash_697232.description:
MK Gadi Eisenkot has asked the Attorney General to intervene to ensure that he receives regular security briefings from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding the current threat landscape.

According to Eisenkot, the updates are necessary "to ensure effective oversight, maintain a proper national decision-making process, and safeguard security interests."

flash_697231.description: Alexander Darchiev, Russia's ambassador to Washington, died unexpectedly on Wednesday. The Russian Foreign Ministry announced his death but did not disclose the cause.

flash_697229.description: A preschool teacher and four assistants were arrested on suspicion of violence against toddlers aged one to three at two private preschools in Ashkelon operating under the same management.

flash_697226.description: Speaking at the Israel Hayom Summit in New York, the newspaper's publisher calls for a stronger Israel-US alliance, Jewish pride, and national unity, warning that Israel must aspire to more than survival.

flash_697224.description: Prosecutors are refusing to back down from their entrenched position. Attorney Besserglik criticizes the attorney general's refusal to accept the proposal put forward by the judges in Netanyahu's trial.

flash_697221.description:
Samaria Regional Council head Yossi Dagan claims that French immigration authorities denied him entry to the country last week, informing him that he was not permitted to cross the border into France.

Read more.

flash_697267.description: Our desire for outside approval should not outweigh our commitment to discovering and fulfilling our own responsibilities.

flash_697266.description: The question in the Haftorah is "How have You loved us?" and the answer is one we must appreciate.

flash_697264.description: Blessing, birthright and destiny: Why does Yitzchak love Esav?

flash_697262.description:
Israeli basketball player Danny Wolf recorded a double-double as the Brooklyn Nets cruised to a 145-111 road victory over the New Orleans Pelicans in NBA action on Wednesday night.

Wolf finished with 10 points, 11 rebounds, and four assists. The win improved Brooklyn's record to 3-8.

flash_697261.description: Israel's Ambassador to the Netherlands summoned to the Foreign Ministry after criticizing Smotrich and Ben Gvir, saying, "There are people among us we would rather not have with us."

flash_697259.description: Likud MK Moshe Saada calls for a unity government including all right-wing bloc parties, opposes relying on Arab parties, and accuses the change bloc of hypocrisy over haredi military enlistment.

flash_697257.description: Turkish President Erdogan accuses Israel of genocide and environmental destruction at the UN climate summit, prompting a sharp response from Jerusalem.

flash_697255.description: In a letter to the Central Elections Committee chairman, Likud claims authorities have failed to adequately investigate complaints of election irregularities.

flash_697253.description: A three-story building collapses in Brooklyn's Flatbush neighborhood, killing at least one person and injuring 10 others as rescuers search for a trapped victim.

flash_697251.description: CNN projects that Democratic candidate Scott Colom has defeated incumbent Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in the midterm Senate race in Mississippi, a state considered a Republican stronghold.

flash_697247.description: Trump reportedly authorizes VP Vance to lead renewed negotiations with Iran, with a possible meeting in Qatar despite Tehran's demands and doubts over a deal.

flash_697245.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

flash_697241.description: The government approved a budget of NIS 45.1 million to bring approximately 600 members of the Bnei Menashe community from northeastern India to Israel in the first half of 2027.

flash_697239.description: The former Degel HaTorah chairman is trying to prevent haredim from joining the bloc opposing Netanyahu, while his successor, Yaakov Asher, promotes the move.

flash_697299.description: The judges in Prime Minister Netanyahu's trial rejected the attorney general's request not to attend a hearing on the continued conduct of the trial and ordered her to appear this coming Wednesday.

flash_697298.description:
The Supreme Court unanimously rejected an appeal by the Population and Immigration Authority, ruling that conversions conducted by the private Orthodox rabbinical court "Ahavat HaGer," headed by Rabbi Haim Amsalem, must be recognized for the purpose of obtaining immigrant status.

The justices determined that the rabbinical court is a serious institution that carefully examines the sincerity of conversion candidates.

flash_697296.description: A quarter-century of trial and error, from Afghanistan and Iraq to Iran, should have taught Washington a lesson about the limits of power. Opinion.

flash_697294.description: Miriam Peretz says her son Elyasaf will leave the Knesset if Yashar joins Arab parties in government, responding to criticism from a bereaved mother.

flash_697292.description: Over five years after 45 people died at a Lag Ba'omer celebration in Meron, investigators expected to focus on police officials, safety and security personnel.

flash_697290.description: Appeals against the election results can be filed over the coming week. Likud's legal adviser discusses evidence, testimony and documents to be submitted in an appeal challenging results at polling stations in Arab communities.

flash_697288.description: Healthy two-year-old girl rushed to Shaare Zedek after flu complication causes seizures; hospital says she did not receive flu shot.

flash_697286.description: Rabbi Eliyahu gave a video address saying that the results at The ballot box have exposed a threat to Israel even greater than Iran.

flash_697284.description: The lessson: We need people to live their Yiddishkeit because it’s not something which is just taught. It needs to be caught.

flash_697282.description: The safety and comfort Jews around the world once knew seem like a distant memory. Be it the anti-Israel protests throughout the West or the plethora of recently elected officials who voice their disdain for the one Jewish State-Jews feel alone.

flash_697280.description: Elbit's new five-year deal covers PULS rocket artillery systems and munitions for a European NATO member.

flash_697278.description: Mapping the network that sustains the “Hezbollah Resistance Society."

flash_697276.description: The Trump Administration suffered its losses because of the war in Iran. Not because they fought it. But because they failed to win it. In fact, and this matters - because they refused to fight it. Opinion.

flash_697274.description: A soldier guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier told off Secretary Pete Hegseth and his entourage for overly jovial behavior at the monument.

flash_697272.description: Border Police and Civil Administration forces demolished three homes, a sheep pen, a chicken coop and a dining hall at a hilltop site near Ateret, and confiscated vehicles and equipment.

flash_697270.description: Newly-opened Horbat Burgin site in Judean Foothills features underground hideouts from the era of the Bar Kokhba Revolt, colorful mosaics from a Byzantine church.
